sources.entry: FileMinutes - Find files and take actions, all in one.

summary.name: FileMinutes
summary.one_liner: A native macOS file search and navigation app that lets you search specific folders, browse with arrow keys, filter by file type, and preview files from a search bar.
use_cases: Find invoices or documents in a specific project folder
Search file names instead of contents in Finder
Quickly open or preview files with keyboard shortcuts
Browse folders from the search bar with arrow keys
Manage open Finder windows and tabs
Search inside PDFs, Markdown and text files
summary.what_it_does: FileMinutes is a macOS app for finding files through a search bar. You can limit a search to specific folders using a path prefix, or search everywhere and then narrow results to a folder. It supports filtering by extension (such as .pdf or .txt) or smart categories like .image and .document. Users can browse folders with arrow keys, Tab and Shift-Tab, and preview files with Spacebar. The page also describes favorites, saved search history, open, copy and preview actions, control of open Finder windows and tabs, and content search for PDFs, Markdown, documents and text files. File search relies on the Spotlight index, so external drives work only if Spotlight indexes them.
notable: Path-scoped searches such as downloads>invoice to search one folder
Keyboard-driven browsing with arrow keys and Spacebar preview
Native Swift app, Apple Notarized, no tracking claimed
Uses Spotlight index; supports 14-day free trial of Pro
caveats: Full feature set appears to require FileMinutes Pro; a 14-day free trial is offered before purchase
External drives are searchable only if indexed by Spotlight; otherwise use path navigation
